title: Shipment Management Web Application
tagline: Page Object Model (POM) test architecture in Playwright + TypeScript validating multi-carrier workflows and PostgreSQL state transitions.
theChallenge: Complex multi-step shipping workflows involving dynamic international address validation APIs, state-dependent customs declarations, and asynchronous carrier status updates causing orphaned orders in the warehouse database.
theSolution: Architected a modular Page Object Model (POM) framework in Playwright with TypeScript. Implemented data-driven boundary matrices for postal codes and parcel weights, and built custom fixtures executing direct SQL queries against PostgreSQL to verify backend state changes independently of UI rendering.
highlights: Built resilient POM automation structure for shipment creation, real-time tracking, and multi-carrier status updates.
Automated positive, negative, and boundary test sets across multi-field international shipment forms.
Engineered automated SQL assertions validating shipment records directly in the DB to bypass stale frontend caches.
Integrated trace-based debugging with Playwright Trace Viewer for instantaneous failure diagnosis in CI.

title: Distributor & Retailer CRM Portal
tagline: Modular Java & Selenium WebDriver framework covering smoke and regression suites across tiered distributor workflows.
theChallenge: Multi-tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) where distributors, retailers, and super-admins have differing SKU discount rights, credit ceilings, and inventory allocations. High risk of race-conditions during simultaneous order placements.
theSolution: Developed a modular UI automation framework using Java, Selenium WebDriver, and TestNG. Created reusable page/action methods with explicit synchronized waits to eliminate flaky tests, and pre-seeded test states using REST API endpoints prior to UI verification.
highlights: Designed data-driven test suites validating wholesale pricing matrices and tiered distributor credit limits.
Covered critical smoke and regression scenarios with zero flakiness across dynamic CRM grids.
Conducted exploratory testing uncovering edge-case invoice generation bugs during concurrent order updates.
Delivered 100x clearer test evidence reports with custom Excel logs and structured Allure test outputs.

title: WhatsApp-Powered AI Conversational Bot
tagline: Adversarial conversational testing, intent validation, and asynchronous webhook idempotency verification.
theChallenge: Non-deterministic LLM responses, colloquial slang, multi-language prompt injections, and network packet loss triggering repeated webhook retries that could duplicate e-commerce bot orders.
theSolution: Designed an adversarial test matrix testing 150+ edge-case inputs (emojis, zero-width spaces, rapid-fire messaging, out-of-sequence replies). Validated webhook idempotency headers to ensure zero duplicate transactions occurred under network retry storms.
highlights: Engineered automated checks verifying smooth fallback to human agents when bot confidence fell below 0.70.
Simulated packet-loss retries to prove backend idempotency keys stopped duplicate credit deductions.
Tested edge-case voice note transcriptions and multi-language mixed text (Hinglish / regional terms).
Prevented high-severity bot lockouts during checkout session timeouts.

title: Real-Time Stock Market Analysis Dashboard
tagline: High-frequency streaming data validation, memory leak profiling, and financial indicator boundary testing.
theChallenge: WebSocket streaming engines pushing real-time ticker prices every 200ms with interactive candlestick charts. Risk of DOM memory leaks, chart freezing during high market volatility, and floating-point math rounding errors on financial indicators (RSI, MACD).
theSolution: Conducted 4-hour continuous soak testing to monitor browser heap allocation and garbage collection. Tested WebSocket connection recovery under network throttling, and automated verification of mathematical indicator formulas against verified market benchmark tables.
highlights: Monitored browser memory profiles over extended market open hours, eliminating 2 critical DOM memory leaks.
Validated WebSocket reconnection logic and data packet buffering during simulated 3G/packet drop conditions.
Verified floating-point rounding precision across technical indicators to guarantee zero calculation discrepancies.
Ensured instant UI responsiveness across 50+ concurrent live-updating watchlists.

title: POS System Performance & Mobile App
tagline: High-concurrency stress testing up to 1,000 threads with JMeter and automated Android mobile checkout with Appium.
theChallenge: Peak shopping hours caused severe checkout latency and 504 Gateway Timeouts across 500+ retail store POS terminal registers, threatening retail store operations during festival sale events.
theSolution: Designed and executed comprehensive Apache JMeter test plans utilizing Thread Groups, HTTP Request Samplers, Gaussian Random Timers, and Response Assertions simulating 1,000 concurrent checkout sessions. Automated Android tablet barcode scanning and checkout flows using Appium on emulators.
highlights: Engineered JMeter performance test plans simulating 1,000 virtual users across login, cart, and payment APIs.
Identified and diagnosed a backend database connection pool exhaustion bottleneck, unlocking a 3.2x throughput increase.
Automated Android tablet POS login and checkout workflows with Appium and verified responsive UI state handling.
Summarized latency percentiles (p90, p99), error rates (< 0.05%), and throughput graphs for stakeholder sign-off.
